_comment: Per-school (and per-channel where they differ) GA4 conversion event mapping. VERIFIED = confirmed against live data. On first run for an unverified school, run the event-discovery query (ga4_queries.md) and confirm with the user before building the report.

RAS.status: VERIFIED 2026-07-15 (test 10464: RFI ctrl 142 / V1 273 matched DS-order magnitudes); re-confirmed 2026-07-15 (both events firing property-wide)
RAS.notes: LP channel only. For a PW test on www.rasmussen.edu use the RAS_PW entry - info.rasmussen.edu / landing_page_inquiry return near-zero traffic for a homepage PW test.

AMU.status: VERIFIED 2026-07-15 (test 10989: ctrl 442 RFI / 196 App; mapping cross-checked against cro-incremental-calculator Optimizely metric names 'Visit Page: RFI for AMU' / 'Event | AMU Application Complete')
AMU.notes: App completes fire on apply.apus.edu, NOT the LP hostname - DROP the hostName filter on the abConv query (audience filter alone scopes it). Audience names may lack the (RH#) suffix; match on the page-path fragment, e.g. 'Hero Image | /military-degrees/overview'.

APU.status: VERIFIED 2026-07-15 (event discovery on start.apu.apus.edu: rfi_short_thankyou_apu 3,650/30d; apu_application_completed 709 on apply.apus.edu)
APU.notes: Same two caveats as AMU: app completes fire on apply.apus.edu (drop hostName filter on abConv), and audience names may lack the (RH#) suffix.

RAS_PW.status: VERIFIED 2026-10-02 (test 11044B, Sep 29 - Oct 1: RFI ctrl 48 / v1 43; App ctrl 26 / v1 24; confirmed with the user against the candidate set)
RAS_PW.notes: Candidates ruled out: request_info_click is an RFI BUTTON CLICK, not a completion - a test that moves the form inline suppresses it by design (64 ctrl vs 36 v1 on 11044B) and would read as a false loss. application_complete is the generic twin of pub_application_complete (identical counts); prefer the pub_ event, as with the AMU/APU school-specific events. pub_rfi_complete also fires on www but at ~40% of lead_inquiry volume. Keep the hostName filter: adfs./portal.rasmussen.edu are student-login hosts carrying ~50% as many audience sessions as www.

HON.appEvent: n/a - no Hondros application event in GA4
HON.status: VERIFIED 2026-10-02 (test 11107: event discovery on start.hondros.edu - requestinfomation_lp 3,041/30d; RFI ctrl 304 / v1 310 over Sep 22 - Oct 1)
HON.notes: Hondros has NO application-complete event anywhere in GA4 - App Complete is always 0; appEvent is a deliberate non-matching placeholder so the abConv inList still runs. The PW equivalent of the RFI event is requestinfomation_pw on www.hondros.edu. report_template.html's revenue engine has no HONLP/HONPW segment, so revenue1yr() returns null and no projection renders - publish revenue 0 in reports.json. School reads 'Hondros' in the Asana School field but HON in task names. No HON palette exists, so reports render in the default RAS green.
